info.title: EventBooking API
info.description: EventBooking staff API and anonymous Attendee booking links.

get.description: Anonymous deployment liveness probe.
Anonymous readiness probe; reports whether the database is reachable.
Anonymous Prometheus exposition of the API's meters (design 08).
Anonymous entry document listing every top-level resource.
Reads display name, staff number, roles, scope and granted capabilities (FR-10.8). Requires staff auth; no capability, and answers even when the staff number claim is missing or malformed.
Reads the three tabs and their counts (FR-13), optionally filtered by location.
Reads every location in code order. Requires staff auth.

post.description: Creates a location with its code, name, address and IANA zone.

put.description: Updates a location's name, address, zone and active flag. Refuses a zone change or a deactivation while the location has open proposals or future events.

get.description: Reads every appointment type with its current Manager's display name.

post.description: Creates an appointment type with its code and name.

put.description: Updates an appointment type's name and active flag. Refuses a deactivation while it is listed on an open proposal or a future event, or mapped by an active group.

get.description: Reads every attendee group with its requirement type ids and member count.

post.description: Creates an attendee group mapping at least one active appointment type.

put.description: Updates a group's name, requirement mapping and active flag. A mapping change re-derives every member's requirements and is refused while any member holds an active original booking (FR-1.5).

get.description: Reads the single settings row and its version.

put.description: Updates invite expiry, automatic retry count and option count. Existing invites keep the values they were issued under.

get.description: Reads every profile with its display name, staff number, read-only roles and scope.

put.description: Sets or clears one profile's appointment-type scope. Assigning a type that another Manager holds displaces them, and the response names who.

get.description: Reads the proposals listing the caller's own appointment type (FR-2.13), filtered by status and location, one keyset page at a time.

post.description: Creates a proposal for one location, window and listed appointment-type set. A proposal listing only the proposer's type is confirmed on creation.

put.description: Records the caller's type's acceptance with its headcount, or revises it while the proposal is open. The last missing acceptance confirms the event.

delete.description: Withdraws the caller's type's acceptance while the proposal is open.

post.description: Withdraws the whole proposal. Judged against the proposing appointment type, so a Manager inherits it from a predecessor.

get.description: Reads events filtered by location, date range and appointment type. A Manager sees their own type's capacity; an Admin or Coordinator sees every type.
Reads the active events whose window has not started, which are the ones a cancellation can still reach (FR-7.2).
Reads one event with its capacities, filtered the same way the list is. An event outside the caller's scope reads as not found.

put.description: Replaces the total headcount for one appointment type on an active event. The type must be the caller's own, and the total must still cover every active booking.

post.description: Cancels an event, voiding its bookings and re-inviting the affected attendees. Two-step: without confirm=true the call reports its consequence and changes nothing.

get.description: Reads attendees filtered by status, group, readiness and a name or email prefix, one keyset page at a time, with each row's latest delivery status.

post.description: Creates an attendee in a group, deriving their requirements from it.

put.description: Updates an attendee's name, email and group (FR-4.2). A group change that would alter an active booking's requirements is refused.

delete.description: Deletes an attendee and their bookings (FR-4.5). Two-step: without confirm=true the call reports its consequence and changes nothing.

post.description: Imports attendees from CSV content, all or nothing (FR-4.3). At most 1000 rows and 1 MB.

get.description: Counts the events this attendee could currently be offered at the given locations.

post.description: Issues an invitation restricted to the chosen locations, returning Invited or AwaitingAvailability when too few events are eligible.
Starts missed-appointment recovery for the attendee's outstanding no-show types (FR-9.1), optionally widening the locations.

get.description: Reads the attendee's bookings with their event and location.

post.description: Cancels one booking on the attendee's behalf (FR-7.1). Two-step: without confirm=true the call reports its consequence and changes nothing.
Regenerates and re-queues the newest failed or stale delivery (FR-11.3).

get.description: Reads the calculated readiness and any outstanding appointment types.
Searches audit entries, scoped to the buckets the caller's capabilities reach (FR-12.3), one keyset page at a time.
Reads the audit history of one attendee.
Reads the audit history of one event, including its proposal.
Reads the events listing the caller's type and ending between seven days ago and fourteen days ahead.
Reads the minimum-data roster for one event (FR-8.1): name, email, the caller's own type's appointment status, and nothing else.

put.description: Moves one booking appointment to a target status, or applies a bounded correction. A same-status submission is idempotent.

get.description: Downloads the roster as CSV (FR-8.7, FR-8.8), with formula characters neutralised.
Anonymous. Shows the live options, topped up (FR-5.8), or the expired state.

post.description: Anonymous. Confirms one offered event and returns the booking and its manage link.

get.description: Anonymous. Shows the booking and whether it can still be cancelled.

post.description: Anonymous. Cancels the booking and optionally asks for a new time.

remainingCapacity.description: The remaining count after the call.

outcome.description: Which of the four outcomes happened.

inviteId.description: The fresh or still-pending invite, when there is one.

AttendeeCancelOutcome.description: The truthful outcome: cancelled, reinvited, noEligibleEvents or reinvitePending.

AttendeeCsvError.description: Defines attendee csv error for the current use case.

AttendeeImportOutcome.description:
Accepted is false when the file was rejected. The result itself is still a success — a rejected
upload is a normal outcome with a list of row errors, not a failed request.

AwaitingAvailabilityRow.description: Defines awaiting availability row for the current use case.

cancelledCount.description: Bookings moved to cancelled (preview: bookings that would be).

reinvitedCount.description: Cancelled attendees issued a replacement invite.

CancelEventOutcome.description: How many bookings were cancelled, rebooked, or left awaiting availability.

EventCapacityRow.description: Defines event capacity row for the current use case.

NoResponseRow.description: Defines no response row for the current use case.

eventId.description: The event identifier, or null while the proposal stays open.

ProposeEventOutcome.description: The proposal that was created, and the event when it confirmed immediately.

eventId.description: The event identifier, or null while the proposal stays open.

RecordAcceptanceOutcome.description: The proposal status after accepting, and the event when this was the final accept.

appointmentTypeId.description: The scope now set, or null when cleared.

displacedManagerDisplayName.description: The displaced holder's name, when any.

SetStaffScopeOutcome.description: The scope change plus the displaced Manager's display name when any.
